meta.why: EA Flood Map for Planning zones 2 and 3
meta.method: walk-portals.mjs pdg harvest flood-risk-zone: the platform's spatial query (geometry intersects the zone box) in pages of 500; whole geometries kept (not cut), rounded to 6 decimals, simplified (Douglas-Peucker, 0.000005 degrees, about 0.5 m) to keep the file small; polygons that cross the box edge are cut at the box (clipped_to_zone: true; a hole that crosses the edge is cut as a ring, so a cut polygon is for display, not for area sums); in_zone, whole_in_zone, in_cw (Canary Wharf registry box -0.03, 51.498, -0.005, 51.51); fields kept as published except empty ones and fields matching /e-?mail|phone|tel(ephone)?$|^tel|contact|^fax|mobile|^owner_?name|person|officer|case_?officer|agent_?name|applicant/i
